acceptanceCriteria: Step 9's expected-state text lists the `NOTE unbound-commits` form that DOGFOOD.md:241 documents, or the note is suppressed for commits outside the change scope.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the fresh-agent leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, BASE d18db3d). Step 9 printed `NOTE unbound-commits count=1` for a taskman commit; the expected-state text at DOGFOOD.md:73 names only the NOT_OBSERVED form.
title: DOGFOOD.md step 9 expected state omits the `NOTE unbound-commits count=N` form
